target: scaffold.sh stamp — checksums record what UPSTREAM shipped, so a kept local edit reads modified rather than stale (the silent-revert bug)
cmd: source "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/scaffold.sh"; source "$FIXTURES/scaffold-fixture.sh"; export SCAFFOLD_STAMP_PATH=scripts/.agentic-scaffold.json; scaffold_fake_plugin fake 0.9.0; scaffold_put fake/scripts/lib/tracker.sh UPSTREAM; scaffold_put scripts/lib/tracker.sh MY_LOCAL_EDIT; scaffold_write_stamp fake software-interviewed src; UP=$(scaffold_checksum fake/scripts/lib/tracker.sh); DISK=$(scaffold_checksum scripts/lib/tracker.sh); STAMPED=$(scaffold_stamped_sum scripts/lib/tracker.sh); jq -n --arg stamped "$STAMPED" --arg up "$UP" --arg disk "$DISK" --arg state "$(scaffold_status fake software-interviewed | awk -F'\t' '$1=="scripts/lib/tracker.sh"{print $2}')" '{matches_upstream: ($stamped == $up), matches_disk: ($stamped == $disk), state: $state}'
